name: Lighthouse
description:
Harborline's public website went live in a hurry. Find what the developers left behind.

Target: the Harborline VM.
hint: Developers sometimes leave notes where browsers don't display them.

name: Welcome Aboard
description: New staff get a welcome pack. Can you get one too?
hint: Not every service needs a password. Scan all common ports.

name: Manifest Desk
hint: Combine who works here with how their first password is made.

name: Cargo Hold
description: Turn portal access into a shell on the server. The flag is in /var/www.
hint: A blocklist only stops what its author thought of.

name: Crew Quarters
description: Become a real user on the box. Submit user.txt.
hint: Web apps need credentials to reach their database. People reuse them.

name: Captain's Log
hint: Something runs on a schedule. Check who can change it.
